prompts:
Use case: productivity-visual. Generate one finished 16:9 1920x1080-style pitch slide concept for Sachet. Mostly white, dark navy sans-serif, orange accent numerals, orange dotted curved connectors, thin cool-gray rounded borders. Reference1 is previous slide for STYLE only, don't copy its content. Reference2 is actual analyst candidate review screenshot, reference3 is actual release-admin evaluation screenshot. Use focused, large readable crops from these screenshots, preserving real prototype text accurately. Crop off surrounding blurred background, navigation, scrollbar and unrelated baseline version. Do not invent related reports or rollback buttons absent in the screenshot. This is a presentation layout concept, not a new app UI.
Title centered top, equivalent54pt: "Emerging Scam Patterns"
Main statement below, equivalent32pt: "User reports become candidate patterns through review, testing, and controlled activation."
Four numbered flow steps with meaningful text:
"01  Share with consent" — "The user previews and approves a minimized report."
"02  Review related reports" — "An analyst examines similarities and supporting evidence."
"03  Test a candidate pattern" — "Check scam examples and legitimate interactions for unwanted warnings."
"04  Activate or roll back" — "An administrator approves the update and can reverse it."
Two large screenshot sections: "Analyst review" featuring actual Review the candidate modal, and "Pattern evaluation & release" featuring Release deposit review evaluated card and Evaluate / Activate controls. Keep synthetic workflow narrative, needs more evidence decision, reasoning entry and save-review button intact as shown; no claim that this screenshot is the final accepted state. Evaluation card shows "Engineering checks passed", "1 improvements · 0 regressions", "Inspect 10 synthetic checks" and actual limited evaluation text. These are local synthetic checks, never label them measured real-world accuracy. Preserve screenshot disclaimer text as part of UI; don't add standalone disclaimer line.
IMPORTANT: No explanatory sentence or slogan beneath the flow. Completely omit both 'A user report does not automatically change detection' AND 'Every pattern update is reviewed, tested, and reversible.' Do not replace them with anything. Only the title, main statement, 4-step flow, two prototype panels and unobtrusive footer.
Footer left "Sachet · Team ANKOR", center "Prototype screens · Synthetic demo report", right "RAKSHAM · IIT Delhi | Statement 2".
No decorative AI-looking icons, photos, orange strips, gradient backgrounds. Do not make slide empty or sparse. No team member names. No Groq/Gemini note. Exact spellings.
Variant1: Four equal bordered numbered flow boxes across upper quarter, orange dotted arrows between them. Lower two columns each with a large focused screenshot. Analyst review 48% width left, evaluation release 52% right. Remove screenshot outer blank margins to enlarge content, balanced tall panels under editorial headings. Strong tidy grid.
